name: Vignette
description: Darkens or tints the edges of the picture towards a colour, in linear light.

params.label: Amount
params.doc: How far the edges move towards the vignette colour.

params.label: Radius
params.doc: How far from the centre the effect starts; the corner of the picture is 1.

params.label: Softness
params.doc: How gradually the effect fades in beyond the radius.

params.label: Roundness
params.doc: 0 follows the shape of the picture, 1 is a circle.

params.label: Colour
params.doc: The colour the edges move towards, in display colour.
